description: A whole level played through main.ts's timing (tests/appModel.ts) by appModel's `play` policy at a fixed frame time. events: [frame delta, kind, a, b] with kind 0 = tap (column, slot), 1 = claim (slot, cell: a truck is sent), 2 = collect (cell: its truck arrived), 3 = +1 Slot; a tap or +1 Slot in frame f happens before that frame's update. poses: on sampled frames, every truck on the road in update order as cell, x, y (route center line, design px), and the cells of the trucks still queued in each ramp lane. docs/SESSION.md.
name: s-01-strawberry-2x-60fps
